title: GC-MS guided phytochemical profiling of Bauhinia tomentosa flowers: molecular docking against HPV-E6 and p53 in cervical cancer.
one_liner_zh: 该文对Bauhinia tomentosa花提取物进行GC-MS成分分析，并针对HPV-E6和p53蛋白做分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: Cervical cancer remains a major cause of mortality among women in low- and middle-income countries, highlighting the need for affordable plant-based therapeutics. Bauhinia tomentosa (Mantharai), traditionally used for inflammatory and anticancer applications, has not been systematically explored for flower-derived anticancer compounds. In this study, methanolic flower extracts were profiled using GC-MS, followed by molecular docking, ADMET assessment, and drug-likeness evaluation. GC-MS analysis identified 45 metabolites, including furanones, phenolics, fatty acids, phytosterols, and triterpenes. Major constituents included stigmasterol (18.28%), gamma-sitosterol (12.28%), 5-hydroxymethylfurfural (14.01%), and 4-H-pyran-4-one derivatives (13.68%). Docking against cervical cancer targets HPV-E6 (PDB: 4XR8) and p53 (PDB: 1TUP) revealed gamma-sitosterol as the strongest binder (-7.8 and - 7.5 kcal/mol, respectively), followed by lupeol and stigmasterol, outperforming cisplatin and comparable to bicalutamide. ADMET predictions indicated favorable oral bioavailability, high gastrointestinal absorption, and low toxicity, although sterols exhibited mild CYP450 inhibition and bis(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate showed hepatotoxicity. This study presents the first integrated phytochemical and in silico evaluation of B. tomentosa flowers, identifying gamma-sitosterol and related phytosterols as promising lead molecules for cervical cancer therapy, warranting further experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 宫颈癌仍然是低收入和中等收入国家女性死亡的主要原因，凸显了对经济实惠的植物来源治疗药物的需求。马兜铃藤（Bauhinia tomentosa，Mantharai）传统上用于炎症和抗癌应用，但其花来源的抗癌化合物尚未被系统探索。本研究采用GC-MS对甲醇花提取物进行谱图分析，随后进行分子对接、ADMET评估和药物相似性评价。GC-MS分析鉴定出45种代谢物，包括呋喃酮类、酚类、脂肪酸、植物甾醇和三萜类。主要成分包括豆甾醇（stigmasterol，18.28%）、γ-谷甾醇（gamma-sitosterol，12.28%）、5-羟甲基糠醛（5-hydroxymethylfurfural，14.01%）和4-H-吡喃-4-酮衍生物（13.68%）。针对宫颈癌靶点HPV-E6（PDB：4XR8）和p53（PDB：1TUP）的对接结果显示，γ-谷甾醇为最强结合剂（分别为-7.8和-7.5 kcal/mol），其次是羽扇豆醇（lupeol）和豆甾醇，其表现优于顺铂，且与比卡鲁胺相当。ADMET预测表明其具有良好的口服生物利用度、高胃肠道吸收和低毒性，尽管甾醇类表现出轻微的CYP450抑制，邻苯二甲酸二(2-乙基己基)酯显示出肝毒性。本研究首次对B. tomentosa花进行了综合植物化学和计算机模拟评价，鉴定出γ-谷甾醇及相关植物甾醇作为宫颈癌治疗的有前景的先导分子，有待进一步实验验证。
